svg.title: Sequence diagram
svg.desc: Sequence diagram with 6 actors: Caller, App, Git, Launcher, Job, Store. Messages: Caller to App: POST lane-runs with lane and sha; App to Caller: 403, nothing cloned (reply); App to Caller: 400 naming the rule, no runId (reply); App to Caller: 429 naming the limit (reply); App to Caller: 202 with runId, status running (reply); App to Git: clone the project's own source, checkout the exact sha; App to Launcher: post lane job, network none, allowlisted digest, command verbatim; Launcher to Job: start container with checkout at /w; Job to Launcher: exit code (reply); App to Launcher: poll every 2 s until terminal; App to App: skip DELETE on purpose, job not confirmed gone; App to Launcher: DELETE the job; Launcher to App: confirmed gone (2xx or 404), or not confirmed (reply); App to Store: write the receipt, with checkoutRetained when the job is not confirmed gone; App to App: remove the checkout; App to App: keep the checkout for a sweep not yet built; Caller to App: GET lane-runs by runId or by sha; App to Caller: the receipt, or none for a refused request (reply).
